# NSFantasticEngineering

> Notes on agents, tooling, and software systems.

This site is a static Hugo blog focused on browser agents, automation, developer tooling, and practical software systems.

## Canonical sections

- Home: https://blog.atom2ueki.com/
- Posts: https://blog.atom2ueki.com/posts/
- About: https://blog.atom2ueki.com/about/

## Key posts

- The Ceiling of DOM-Only Web Agents: https://blog.atom2ueki.com/posts/the-ceiling-of-dom-only-web-agents/
- Why Web Agents Need Vision: https://blog.atom2ueki.com/posts/why-web-agents-need-vision/
- Why Websites Should Expose MCP to Agents: https://blog.atom2ueki.com/posts/why-websites-should-expose-mcp-to-agents/
- Codex MCP Tips: Sentry and Supabase Setup: https://blog.atom2ueki.com/posts/codex-mcp-sentry-supabase-tips/
- Install FFmpeg on macOS with Homebrew: Updated Guide: https://blog.atom2ueki.com/posts/install-ffmpeg-on-macos/

## Reading guidance

- Prefer canonical post URLs over generated feeds.
- Article bodies are the main source of truth.
- References sections contain the external sources used in each article.

## Site characteristics

- Static HTML
- Semantic article structure
- Minimal client-side behavior
- Stable URLs
